---
title: "Week Results"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis
source("_data.R")
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

for (w in sort(unique(weekly_summary$week))) {
  cat(paste0("\n## Week ", w, "\n\n"))

  week_totals <- weekly_summary %>%
    filter(week == w) %>%
    arrange(desc(week_dollars)) %>%
    select(
      Participant        = user,
      Correct     = correct,
      Total       = total,
      `Base $`    = base_dollars,
      `Bonus $`   = bonus_dollars,
      `Missed $`  = missed_dollars,
      `Week Total`= week_dollars
    )

  print(kable(week_totals))
  cat("\n")

  week_detail <- results %>%
    filter(week == w, !is.na(correct_pick)) %>%
    select(
      Participant          = user,
      Game          = game_id,
      Pick          = pick,
      `Correct Pick`= correct_pick,
      Bonus         = bonus,
      Correct       = correct
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Correct = ifelse(Correct, "✅", "❌"),
      Bonus   = ifelse(Bonus, "✅", "")
    )

  print(kable(week_detail))
  cat("\n")
}
```
